about: Backcountry huts and cabins: booking, price, beds and what's inside, from the clubs and parks that run them (alex 2026-10-30: "There is huts missing! Look for more and keep it updated. If you need to book it tell it and add the link to book"). winter.js puts these tags on the matching OpenStreetMap hut (same name within 5 km, or any hut within 250 m), and adds the hut to the map when OpenStreetMap doesn't have it. 'operators' fill in huts of a club or park with no entry of their own. Keys are OpenStreetMap's (capacity, fee, charge, reservation, reservation:website, website, operator, description, heating, drinking_water, toilets), plus drinking_water:note, toilets:note, season, booking:note and winter:access (where to park in winter and what's skied). Prices in CAD. 'todo': huts found but not yet placed (no exact spot), for the monthly hut check (scripts/check-huts.mjs).
